_handoff.scope: Public-workflow pass for a new BESCOM electricity connection in Bengaluru. Only public BESCOM pages, public form controls, FAQ, and eligibility guidance were inspected. No login, applicant/property value, temporary account ID, upload, payment, or submission was made.
_handoff.observationNote: The public route is visible through JVS and normal new-connection pages. Case-specific eligibility, document validation, demand, field inspection, and supply completion remain Unknown.

claims.text: The public BESCOM materials expose a JVS New Connection route that does not require customer-portal login, and a normal New Connection route under Other Services for LT/HT/EHT/MC/MSB categories.

The public form displays stages for application type, temporary/permanent or temporary account ID where applicable, personal details, supply address, correspondence address, location, miscellaneous details, LEC details where applicable, and document upload.
claims.notes: Blank controls only; no personal or property value was entered.

claims.text: BESCOM public guidance lists ownership/occupancy, tax, identity/address, solar-water-heater, agreement, wiring and contractor test-report document classes, with requiredness depending on the chosen category and premises.
claims.notes: Do not treat the FAQ's long list as a universal checklist.

claims.text: The public eligibility page excludes or conditions JVS cases involving line extension/modification, certain tall or large buildings, occupancy-certificate premises, unauthorised/revenue/abandoned layouts, HT category, and incomplete wiring/meter-board/service cable; public pages also differ between 17.5 kW and 18 kW-excluding-18 kW wording.
claims.notes: No property-specific eligibility decision was attempted.

claims.text: The public FAQ says submission leads to a confirmation page and charge breakdown/demand letter; for normal new connection it says only the application fee can be paid online and remaining additional charges are paid at the SDO office.
claims.notes: No demand, payment, or receipt was generated.

claims.text: BESCOM displays conditional targets of 24 hours after requisite-fee payment for qualifying JVS domestic/commercial cases without line extension and 7/15 days for stated Bengaluru EODB load bands depending on RoW.
claims.notes: Displayed targets do not establish a case clock or guarantee supply.
